title: 第一次坐地铁 Dì yī cì zuò dìtiě — The first metro ride
summary: A first metro ride turns into a wrong exit, a kind station worker, and a free lesson.
attribution: Original content authored for this project.

body.speaker: 旁白
body.py: Xiǎo Yún jīntiān qù péngyou jiā.
body.en: Xiao Yun is going to a friend house today.

body.speaker: 旁白
body.py: tā dì yī cì zuò dìtiě.
body.en: It is her first ride on the metro.

body.speaker: 小云
body.en: How do you buy a ticket on this machine?

body.speaker: 旁白
body.zh: 她按了两下，票没有出来。
body.py: tā àn le liǎng xià, piào méi yǒu chūlái.
body.en: She presses twice and no ticket comes out.

body.speaker: 小云
body.zh: 请问，我去中山路，坐哪条线？
body.py: qǐng wèn, wǒ qù Zhōngshān Lù, zuò nǎ tiáo xiàn?
body.en: Excuse me, I am going to Zhongshan Road. Which line?

body.speaker: 站务员
body.zh: 坐二号线，四站以后换一号线。
body.py: zuò èr hào xiàn, sì zhàn yǐhòu huàn yí hào xiàn.
body.en: Take line two, then change to line one after four stops.

body.speaker: 小云
body.py: wǒ zuò guò zhàn le zěnme bàn?
body.en: What if I miss my stop?

body.speaker: 站务员
body.zh: 别担心。对面往回坐，很快。
body.py: bié dānxīn. duìmiàn wǎng huí zuò, hěn kuài.
body.en: Do not worry. Go back on the other side, it is quick.

body.speaker: 旁白
body.zh: 小云进去了，可是出口不对。
body.py: Xiǎo Yún jìnqù le, kěshì chūkǒu bú duì.
body.en: She gets in, but the exit is wrong.

body.speaker: 旁白
body.py: tā zài qiáo shàng zhàn le wǔ fēn zhōng.
body.en: She stands on the bridge for five minutes.

body.speaker: 小云
body.zh: 刚才那个人说得对，我应该看清楚。
body.py: gāngcái nàgè rén shuō de duì, wǒ yīnggāi kàn qīngchu.
body.en: That person was right, I should look carefully.

body.speaker: 旁白
body.zh: 第二次，她先看墙上的图，再走。
body.py: dì èr cì, tā xiān kàn qiáng shàng de tú, zài zǒu.
body.en: The second time she reads the map first, then walks.

body.speaker: 小云
body.py: zhǎodào le! Zhōngshān Lù dào le.
body.en: Found it! Zhongshan Road is here.

body.speaker: 旁白
body.en: Her friend is waiting at the door.

body.speaker: 朋友
body.zh: 你第一次坐就找到了，真快。
body.py: nǐ dì yī cì zuò jiù zhǎodào le, zhēn kuài.
body.en: You found it on your first ride, that is fast.

body.speaker: 小云
body.zh: 不是我的本事，是那个人的话。
body.py: bú shì wǒ de běnshi, shì nàgè rén de huà.
body.en: It is not my skill, it is what that person said.

blocks.title: Words in this story
body: 买票 mǎi piào — to buy a ticket
坐过站 zuò guò zhàn — to ride past your stop

blocks.body: Think about it: What did the station worker tell her, and what does Xiao Yun learn at the end? Say one of those two things in Chinese.
